member.name: T:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl
member.summary: Interface exposed by SaCM Client Plugin to use by SubAgents. It allows SubAgents to query the status of other SubAgents and request that they be started, stopped and restarted.

member.name: E:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.SubAgentStarted
member.summary: Event raised when a SubAgent is started.

member.name: E:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.SubAgentStopped
member.summary: Event raised when a SubAgent is stopped.

member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.IsSubAgentRunningAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Query if a particular SubAgent is running. This method should not throw.
member.returns: True if agent is running. False otherwise.

member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.StartSubAgentAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Request that a SubAgent be started...
member.returns: True if agent was already running. False if it had to start it.
member.exception: Will throw if it can't start the SubAgent for any reason.

member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.StopSubAgentAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Request that a SubAgent be stopped...
member.returns: True if agent was already stopped. False if it had to stop it.
member.exception: Will throw if it can't stop the SubAgent for any reason.

member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.RestartSubAgentAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Request that a SubAgent be restarted...
member.returns: True if agent was already stopped. False if it had to stop it. If already stopped, it will start it again and return false.
member.exception: Will throw if it can't restart the SubAgent for any reason.

member.name: M:Dell.UnifiedAgent.SubAgentControl.Interfaces.ISubAgentControl.IsSubAgentRegisteredAsync(System.Guid)
member.summary: Query if a particular SubAgent is registered. This method should not throw.
member.returns: True if agent is registered. False otherwise.
